subject: chemistry-9
description: Authentic 12-mark Section A Federal Board examination simulator covering Stoichiometry, Air Pollution, Water Treatment, and Biochemistry.

questions.question: Which of the following nitrogenous bases is found in RNA but NOT in DNA:
questions.explanation: DNA contains adenine, thymine, cytosine, and guanine, whereas RNA replaces thymine with uracil.

questions.question: The biological oxidation of carbohydrates in human metabolism yields approximately how much energy per gram:
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates and proteins yield about 4 kcal/g, whereas fats yield approximately 9 kcal/g of metabolic energy.

questions.question: Precipitation is scientifically classified as “acid rain” when its pH falls below:
questions.explanation: Natural unpolluted rainwater has a pH of ~5.6 due to dissolved atmospheric carbon dioxide forming weak carbonic acid; rain with pH < 5.6 is acid rain.

questions.question: All of the following atmospheric gases are harmful air pollutants EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Nitrogen gas (N2) is an inert, harmless natural component comprising 78% of dry air, whereas NO2, SO2, and SO3 are toxic pollutants.

questions.question: The mass of oxygen contained in one mole of water (H₂O) is:
questions.explanation: One mole of water (18 g) contains 2 moles of hydrogen (2 g) and 1 mole of oxygen atoms (16 g).

questions.question: Molecules such as CO₂ and H₂O that contain atoms of more than one element are classified as:
questions.explanation: Molecules composed of two or more different elements chemically bonded together are called hetero-atomic molecules.

questions.question: Which of the following compounds is chemically decomposed during thermal dissociation into nitrogen and hydrogen gases:
questions.explanation: Ammonia decomposes at elevated temperatures over a catalyst: 2NH3 → N2 + 3H2.

questions.question: Which of the following lists consists entirely of homonuclear diatomic molecules:
questions.explanation: N2, H2, and O2 each consist of two identical atoms chemically bonded together.

questions.question: The molar mass of elemental carbon (C-12 standard) containing exactly 6.022 × 10²³ atoms is:
questions.explanation: One mole of carbon atoms has a mass equal to its atomic mass expressed in grams, which is 12.011 g.

questions.question: The chemical formula that represents the simplest whole-number ratio of atoms of each element in a compound is the:
questions.explanation: The empirical formula expresses the simplest whole-number ratio of atoms in a compound (e.g. CH2O for glucose).

questions.question: The major chemical pollutants responsible for catalytic depletion of stratospheric ozone are:
questions.explanation: CFCs release chlorine free radicals under UV irradiation in the stratosphere, each of which can break down over 100,000 ozone molecules.

questions.question: The empirical formula of glucose (molecular formula C₆H₁₂O₆) is:
questions.explanation: Dividing the subscripts 6, 12, 6 by their greatest common divisor (6) gives the simplest ratio 1:2:1, resulting in CH2O.
